query: SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest($2::bytea[],$3::bytea[],$4::text[]) AS w(unit_id,fragment_id,family) LEFT JOIN lctx_serving.retrieval_fragments f ON f.generation_digest=$1 AND f.unit_id=w.unit_id AND f.fragment_id=w.fragment_id AND f.family=w.family WHERE f.fragment_id IS NULL) AS "valid!"
